key_insight: A neuro-symbolic AI system can accurately abstract complex pathology quality measures from narrative reports by combining language-model extraction with symbolic reasoning.
clinical_relevance: This could reduce manual chart review burden and make more pathology quality measures feasible for large-scale clinical reporting.
method: Decomposed each quality measure into atomic questions for stepwise abstraction.
Used case-based refinement with human-in-the-loop alignment to real pathology reports.
Compared NSAI against trained human abstractors on 2,000 independently double-abstracted reports across four CAP measures.
evidence_signal: Against the adjudicated gold standard, NSAI achieved Cohen’s kappa of 0.95, slightly exceeding trained human abstractors at 0.92.
watch_item: Performance depends on careful measure decomposition and case-based refinement, so real-world deployment may require continued human oversight and validation across sites and report styles.
paper_title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for Automated Pathology Quality Measurement
